items.title: Xi calls for inclusive regional co-op based on solidarity, openness, innovation
items.description: YIN BOGU / XINHUA President Xi Jinping outlined economy and trade, connectivity, innovation and development as four pillars for building an Asia-Pacific community and opening up new prospects for regional cooperation, as he chaired the 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting in Shenzhen, Guangdong province, on Thursday.
